headlines.detail: On track after lap 1 · most: ALO (5)

summary: George Russell won the Dutch Grand Prix Sprint from pole position, 1.4s ahead of Charles Leclerc, with Lando Norris completing the podium.
Fernando Alonso made the biggest climb, from P22 to P18.
There were 2 pit stops in total; the winner stopped 0 times.
Rain fell at some point during the race.
Kimi Antonelli leads the championship by 53 points over Lewis Hamilton.
